title: EVALUATION_REVIEW.json - adversarial EI-line judge verdict (v1.4.0 eval harness)
description: Written by scripts/eval/sciforge_eval.py judge: an adversarial reviewer (try-hard-to-REJECT) scores the finished paper against the EI-conference / general-journal line. Accept line: overall >= 6 AND fatal_flaws empty; human has the final word.

dimensions.description: Six 0-10 dimension scores (novelty_and_positioning, methodological_soundness, experimental_rigor, claim_evidence_alignment, writing_and_structure, reproducibility).
